rows.name: Scrap per tap
rows.desc: Each tap on the scrap pile gives 1 more scrap.

rows.name: Lighter work
rows.desc: Every work bar needs 10% less work, so stations finish parts sooner.

rows.name: Crew size
rows.desc: One more worker slot on every station.

rows.name: Worker speed
rows.desc: Every worker, on the lines and in the yard, delivers a chunk more often.

rows.name: Tap damage
rows.desc: Tap the battlefield to hit the wave. Each tap deals this share of the wave's HP and pays the same share of its bounty.

rows.name: Yard haul
rows.desc: Every yard worker carries 1 more scrap per trip.

rows.name: Pay raises
rows.desc: Mechs on the field earn x1.5 more after every raise interval. Each level allows one more raise.

rows.name: Faster raises
rows.desc: Mechs get their pay raises sooner.

rows.name: Deploy bonus
rows.desc: Every mech pays a bigger fee when it reaches the battlefield.

rows.name: Salvage
rows.desc: Exploding mechs give back part of their scrap cost.

rows.name: Scrap per kill
rows.desc: Every destroyed enemy drops scrap: 1% of its HP per level.

rows.name: New line
rows.desc: Unlocks another assembly line. It starts with empty pads.
